scenarios.name: Ephemeral signing-key loss
scenarios.outcome: RECOVERED: new ephemeral key + manifest seq 2, validator identity (master key) unchanged

scenarios.name: Ephemeral signing-key compromise
scenarios.outcome: RECOVERED: rotation to seq 2; stale seq-1 manifest rejected by the sequence rule (seq <= stored ignored)

scenarios.name: Master-key loss
scenarios.outcome: NOT RECOVERABLE: without the master secret no new manifest can be signed; the only path is a new validator identity (new master key, new VL entry)
scenarios.network_side_cost: SPECIFIED (not measured in lab): new VL publication with a higher sequence, operator coordination, and trust re-establishment; see docs/runbook.md

scenarios.name: Node loss + Shamir restore (3-of-5)
scenarios.outcome: RECOVERED: master secret rebuilt from shares 1, 3, 5 and verified by fingerprint

scenarios.name: Master-key compromise
scenarios.outcome: REVOKED: revocation manifest seq 4294967295 authenticated by the master key; no further manifest for this master key can ever be accepted; the validator must re-onboard as a new identity

model_note: Manifests in this drill are LAB MODELS (JSON with the same fields as a real manifest), not byte-exact postfiatd STObject manifests. Real-manifest parsing is verified separately against the live VL.
